**P1 — Count throttled reads against the polling budget**

This nests the helper's 10-attempt exponential retry inside the 900-iteration state poll (similarly in the runtime-pin and deletion polls). If nine reads are throttled and the tenth returns `Pending`, the outer loop grants another full read budget; repeated cycles can stretch the nominal 15-minute poll to roughly 28 hours and outlive CI. Use the raw read and make `runWithRetry` count transient read failures against one shared attempt/deadline budget, with a regression test alternating throttles and pending responses.
